# Speaker Deck

> > Speaker Deck is a presentation sharing platform that enables users to upload, share, and embed slide decks online with advanced privacy controls and customization features.

Speaker Deck offers both free and Pro subscription tiers, with Pro features including password protection, custom URLs, scheduled publishing, white-label embedding, and collections. The platform serves educators, storyboard artists, and professionals seeking secure presentation sharing, and positions itself as a privacy-focused alternative to SlideShare with Canvas LMS integration.

## Key Topics

- Speaker Deck Pro

## Features & Capabilities

- [Speaker Deck Features Overview](https://speakerdeck.com/features): Complete feature overview and pricing for Speaker Deck Pro plans
- [Privacy Controls](https://speakerdeck.com/features/privacy-controls): Advanced privacy controls with password protection and private URLs
- [Password Protection](https://speakerdeck.com/features/password-protection): Password protection feature for secure presentation sharing
- [Collections](https://speakerdeck.com/features/collections): Collections feature for organizing presentations with Pro features
- [Scheduled Publishing](https://speakerdeck.com/features/scheduled-publishing): Scheduled publishing feature for delayed presentation releases
- [Custom URLs](https://speakerdeck.com/features/custom-urls): Custom URL feature for personalized presentation links
- [Slide Notes](https://speakerdeck.com/features/slide-notes): Slide notes feature for adding custom captions to presentations
- [Remove Branding](https://speakerdeck.com/features/remove-branding): White-label embedding feature for Speaker Deck Pro subscribers
